feature: ADR-0160 shared participant binding retentions and subtree cancellation preflight

windows.scope: Native Windows checks remain pending after prior automatic approval quota rejection; no new native attempt, bypass or valid capture/session.

limitations: BindingArena stores bounded same-stage Reserved/Live participant retentions (32 members/group,4096 groups,16384 total refs). Exclusive prepare guard abort/drop uses no ID/ref/payload; commit returns must-use non-Clone arena-identity handle. No output/source allocation or fabricated Up.

Overlapping retentions independently block take/finish_producer/cancel until all corresponding handles released. Source units and actual payload lifecycles remain unchanged; actual saved ProducerDecision Up may commit, but finish is blocked until metadata retention ends.

cancel_subtree checks all postorder batch retentions before removing any node, preventing sibling/descendant partial deletion. Read-only blocker keys/member queries permit owning actor to identify cross-device groups before explicit output/scope/queue cleanup and retention release.

Release checks arena identity and complete reverse references before mutation; rejected release returns original handle. Same-number foreign handle cannot release victim. IDs monotonically persist after release; overflow rejects and never wraps. Dropping committed handle does not perform metadata/native cleanup.

13 new tests cover Reserved/Live, guard abort/drop, overlapping/unrelated slots, same-number foreign arena, cross-device old/new snapshots, subtree atomic preflight, malformed/mixed-stage members, exact refs/group limits, real ProducerDecision finish, committed Drop, exhausted counter and inconsistent reverse-link release rejection.

Actual Complex shared-group activation/output/branches/projections/lease/replay/repeat integration remains required. This retainer is metadata lifetime only, no OS acceptance or whole-graph rollback proof. KW-SIM/runtime gate stays; native pointer/platform/hardware/GUI/packaging/driver and full objective remain incomplete.
abi: Pure shared Rust binding ownership metadata; no new unsafe/FFI/dependencies/native packet layouts.
